note: Verdicts are what a careful judge should return per criterion id under the judge protocol in docs/task_format.md section 6 (one criterion at a time, evidence quote must occur verbatim and outside masked spans, a hedge does not satisfy a criterion). Scores are recomputed from those verdicts by the formulas in section 6.

gold_paraphrase.json.why: Same four values as gold; every rubric step is argued in different words, so each criterion has a quotable, unmasked sentence.

wrong_core_flipped.json.why: Flipped core: all four values wrong, including every critical arm, so s_core = 0. The rationale asserts crosstalk and a wash-out story and earns nothing.

textbook_prior.json.why: What a model says from priors alone: canonical crosstalk plus feedback rebound. Both critical cross-pathway arms wrong, so s_core = 0; only the on-target criterion is earned.

constant_answer.json.why: Best constant enum policy plus the stem's own mediator noun. It wins the two on-target arms but loses two critical arms, so s_core = 0.

correct_core_wrong_mechanism.json.why: All four values right but the reasoning is invented (compartments, diffusion limits) and uses no premise, so s_judge = 0 and the pass conjunction fails on s_judge >= 0.5.

correct_core_no_rationale.json.why: Correct core, no reasoning at all: no criterion can be satisfied with a verbatim evidence quote, so s_judge = 0.

hedge_everything.json.why: Core is right, every inference is hedged; under the judge protocol a hedge does not satisfy a criterion, so s_judge = 0.
